summary: Zentek Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) furnishing a September 14, 2026 corporate update. Disclosed items were operational and promotional rather than transactional: Atrium Research initiated sponsored coverage; first orders arrived under an August 20, 2026 Government of Canada standing offer for ZenGUARD HVAC filters, running to August 18, 2027, with no minimum volumes; and Albany graphite bench-scale purification achieved up to 99.99985 wt.% carbon across 4N-5N grades, supporting an August 10, 2026 PEA citing a US$3.85 billion after-tax NPV. No special-situation terms; watch commercialization and PEA technical report filing on SEDAR+ within 45 days.
